# CP-G1-PICK-01: HONEST G1 cuRobo friction pick (existing infra; cuRobo approach + friction close, NO FJ).
create_prim(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", prim_type="DomeLight")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", attr_name="inputs:intensity", value=1000.0)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Ground", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, -0.5], scale=[20, 20, 1])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Ground", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
set_physics_scene_config(config={"enable_gpu_dynamics": True, "gravity_magnitude": 9.81, "gravity_direction": [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]})
create_prim(prim_path="/World/G1", prim_type="Xform", position=[0.0, 0.0, 0.793])
add_reference(prim_path="/World/G1", reference_path="/mnt/shared_data/isaac-sim-assets-complete-5.0.0/Assets/Isaac/5.0/Isaac/Samples/Groot/Robots/g1_29dof_with_hand_rev_1_0.usd")
run_usd_script(code="import omni.usd\nfrom pxr import UsdPhysics, UsdGeom, Usd, Sdf, Gf\nstage = omni.usd.get_context().get_stage()\npelvis = stage.GetPrimAtPath('/World/G1/pelvis')\nif pelvis.IsValid():\n    m = UsdGeom.Xformable(pelvis).ComputeLocalToWorldTransform(Usd.TimeCode.Default())\n    pos = m.ExtractTranslation(); rot = m.ExtractRotationQuat()\n    fj = UsdPhysics.FixedJoint.Define(stage, '/World/G1_RootWeld')\n    fj.GetBody1Rel().SetTargets([Sdf.Path('/World/G1/pelvis')])\n    fj.CreateLocalPos0Attr(Gf.Vec3f(float(pos[0]), float(pos[1]), float(pos[2])))\n    fj.CreateLocalRot0Attr(Gf.Quatf(float(rot.GetReal()), Gf.Vec3f(*[float(x) for x in rot.GetImaginary()])))\n    fj.CreateLocalPos1Attr(Gf.Vec3f(0.0,0.0,0.0)); fj.CreateLocalRot1Attr(Gf.Quatf(1.0,0.0,0.0,0.0))\n    print('PICK: root-weld done')\n# STABILIZE all finger drives (asset ships stiffness=1e7 damping=0 mass~0.02kg -> explodes on close).\n_n = 0\nfor _p in stage.Traverse():\n    _nm = _p.GetName().lower()\n    if _p.IsA(UsdPhysics.Joint) and '_hand_' in _nm and ('thumb' in _nm or 'index' in _nm or 'middle' in _nm):\n        for _a, _v in (('drive:angular:physics:stiffness', 10000.0), ('drive:angular:physics:damping', 300.0)):\n            _at = _p.GetAttribute(_a)\n            if not _at or not _at.IsDefined(): _at = _p.CreateAttribute(_a, Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Float)\n            _at.Set(_v)\n        _n += 1\nprint('PICK: stabilized ' + str(_n) + ' finger drives')\n", description="Root-weld the G1 + stabilize finger drives for a stable friction close")
